# telnyx_enterprise_display_identity_records (Data Source)

The Display Identity Records (DIRs) of one enterprise.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enterprise_id` (String) The enterprise id.

### Optional

- `filter_call_reason_contains` (String)
- `filter_display_name_contains` (String)
- `filter_expiring_at_gte` (String)
- `filter_expiring_at_lte` (String)
- `filter_expiring_within_days` (Number)
- `filter_status` (String) DIR lifecycle status. - `draft` - newly created; editable; not yet submitted. - `submitted` / `in_review` - Telnyx is reviewing. - `verified` - approved; phone numbers may be attached. - `rejected` - Telnyx rejected this submission; `rejection_reasons` is populated; customer can edit and resubmit. - `unsuccessful` - system-side error during processing; customer can edit and resubmit. - `suspended` - temporarily disabled (e.g. by an active infringement claim). - `expired` - verification expired; customer must resubmit. - `infringement_claimed` - a trademark/impersonation claim is open against this DIR. - `permanently_rejected` - terminal; cannot be resubmitted. - `delete_requested` - you have requested deletion; the DIR still exists and Telnyx is completing the removal (de-registration and cleanup). A verified DIR keeps serving its branded identity, and keeps billing, until the removal finishes. One of `delete_requested`, `draft`, `expired`, `in_review`, `infringement_claimed`, `permanently_rejected`, `rejected`, `submitted`, `suspended`, `unsuccessful`, `verified`.
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `sort` (String) One of `-created_at`, `-display_name`, `-expiring_at`, `-status`, `-submitted_at`, `-updated_at`, `-verified_at`, `created_at`, `display_name`, `expiring_at`, `status`, `submitted_at`, `updated_at`, `verified_at`.

### Read-Only

- `enterprise_display_identity_records` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enterprise_display_identity_records))

A verified DIR keeps serving its branded identity, and keeps billing, until the removal finishes.

<a id="nestedatt--enterprise_display_identity_records--documents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `enterprise_display_identity_records.documents`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) An optional note describing this document, for example what it proves.
- `document_id` (String) Id returned by the Telnyx Documents API after you upload the file (upload via `POST /v2/documents`; see https://developers.telnyx.com/api/documents).
- `document_type` (String) Type of supporting document. Pick the closest match to what the file actually contains; `other` triggers manual vetting and may slow approval. The matching short_name reference list is at `GET /v2/dir/document_types`.


<a id="nestedatt--enterprise_display_identity_records--rejection_reasons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `enterprise_display_identity_records.rejection_reasons`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String)
- `detail` (String)
- `message` (String) Customer-visible free-text comment from the Telnyx vetting team. Only the first entry of `rejection_reasons` carries this; the rest are `null`.
- `title` (String)
